    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">ASP.NET Core Blazor简介和快速入门二（组件基础）</span>

<div class="lake-content">
<p><span class="ne-text">大家好，我是码农刚子。上一章介绍了Blazor的简介，开发工具及环境，基本语法和一些示例。接下来我们继续了解Blazor 组件相关的基础知识，希望对你有所帮助。</span></p>
<h2 id="ca94f4f9"><span class="ne-text">1、组件生命周期</span></h2>
<h3 id="INAZY"><span class="ne-text">1.简介</span></h3>
<p id="ub59dbacc" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">Blazor的生命周期与React组件的生命周期类似，也分为三个阶段：初始化阶段、运行中阶段和销毁阶段，其相关方法有10个，包括设置参数前、初始化、设置参数之后、组件渲染后以及组件的销毁，但是这些方法有些是重复的，只不过是同步与异步的区别。</span></p>
<h3 id="s5tjR"><span class="ne-text">2.图解</span></h3>
<p id="u2d9b12fa" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">首先将结果图呈现，代码位于第3部分：</span></p>
<p id="u80c89f4e" class="ne-p"><img src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2025/jpeg/61146596/1760404643897-871b9342-6178-485f-9148-b889ed5ba161.jpeg" width="880" id="uaa70dd01" class="ne-image" title=""></p>
<p id="ubb3fe798" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">Blazor生命周期方法主要包括：</span></p>
<table id="h2wPs" class="ne-table">

<p id="ubfeb97c0" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">在所有生命周期函数中，有以下需要注意的点：</span></p>
<p id="ue8b74f87" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">（1）前5种方法的声明都是virtual，除SetParametersAsync为public外，其他的都是protected。</span></p>
<p id="uf558b34e" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">（2）OnAfterRender/OnAfterRenderAsync方法有一个bool类型的形参firstRender，用于指示是否是第一次渲染（即组件初始化时的渲染）。</span></p>
<p id="ub16c0883" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">（3）同步方法总是先于异步方法执行。</span></p>
<p id="u392d77a4" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">（4）Dispose函数需要通过使用@implements指令实现IDisposable接口来实现。</span></p>
<p id="u7b54aa1d" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">（5）StateHasChanged无法被重写，可以被显示调用，以便强制实现组件刷新（如果ShouldRender返回true，并且Blazor认为需要刷新）；当组件状态更改时不必显示调用此函数，也可导致组件的重新渲染（如果ShouldRender返回true），因为其已经在ComponentBase内部的处理过程（第一次初始化设置参数时、设置参数后和DOM事件处理等）中被调用。</span></p>
<h3 id="sQhza"><span class="ne-text">3.代码示例</span></h3>
<h4><span class="ne-text">设置参数时 (<code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text"><span class="ne-text">SetParametersAsync 设置由组件的父组件在呈现树或路由参数中提供的参数。</span></span></code></span></h4>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p id="u4081e199" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">每次调用 ParameterView 时，方法的 参数都包含该组件的SetParametersAsync值集。 通过重写 SetParametersAsync 方法，C#代码可以直接与 ParameterView 参数交互。</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>@page "/set-params-async/{Param?}"

&lt;PageTitle&gt;Set Parameters Async&lt;/PageTitle&gt;

&lt;h1&gt;Set Parameters Async Example&lt;/h1&gt;

&lt;p&gt;@message&lt;/p&gt;

@code {
    private string message = "Not set";

    [Parameter]
    public string? Param { get; set; }

    public override async Task SetParametersAsync(ParameterView parameters)
    {
        if (parameters.TryGetValue&lt;string&gt;(nameof(Param), out var value))
        {
            if (value is null)
            {
                message = "The value of 'Param' is null.";
            }
            else
            {
                message = $"The value of 'Param' is {value}.";
            }
        }

        await base.SetParametersAsync(parameters);
    }
}</code></pre>
<h4><span class="ne-text">组件初始化 (<code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text"><span class="ne-text">OnInitialized 和 OnInitializedAsync 专门用于在组件实例的整个生命周期内初始化组件。 参数值和参数值更改不应影响在这些方法中执行的初始化。 例如，将静态选项加载到下拉列表中，该下拉列表在组件的生命周期内不会更改，也不依赖于参数值，这是在这些生命周期方法之一中执行的操作。 如果参数值或参数值更改会影响组件状态，请改为使用 OnParametersSet{Async}。</span></span></code></span></h4>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p id="u2be16322" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">组件在接收 SetParametersAsync 中的初始参数后初始化，此时，将调用这些方法。</span></p>
<p id="u570db01c" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">如果使用同步父组件初始化，则保证父组件初始化在子组件初始化之前完成。 如果使用异步父组件初始化，则无法确定父组件和子组件初始化的完成顺序，因为它取决于正在运行的初始化代码。</span></p>
<p id="u8346f854" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">对于同步操作，重写 OnInitialized：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>@page "/on-init"

&lt;PageTitle&gt;On Initialized&lt;/PageTitle&gt;

&lt;h1&gt;On Initialized Example&lt;/h1&gt;

&lt;p&gt;@message&lt;/p&gt;

@code {
    private string? message;

    protected override void OnInitialized() =&gt; 
        message = $"Initialized at {DateTime.Now}";
}</code></pre>
<p id="u173ebe7c" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">若要执行异步操作，请替代 <span class="ne-text">OnInitializedAsync<span class="ne-text"> 并使用 <span class="ne-text">await<span class="ne-text"> 运算符：</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
{
    //await ...
    await Task.Delay(2000);    //2秒之后
    message = $"Initialized at {DateTime.Now} after 2 second delay";
}</code></pre>
<p id="u5bfbfc10" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">如果自定义<span class="ne-text">基类<span class="ne-text">与自定义初始化逻辑一起使用，需在基类上调用 <span class="ne-text">OnInitializedAsync<span class="ne-text">：</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
{
    await ...

    await base.OnInitializedAsync();
}</code></pre>
<h4><span class="ne-text">设置参数之后 (<code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text"><span class="ne-text">OnParametersSet<span class="ne-text"> <span class="ne-text">或<span class="ne-text"> <span class="ne-text">OnParametersSetAsync<span class="ne-text"> <span class="ne-text">在以下情况下调用：</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></span></h4>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="u6f8b7268" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">在<span class="ne-text"> <span class="ne-text">OnInitialized<span class="ne-text"> <span class="ne-text">或<span class="ne-text"> <span class="ne-text">OnInitializedAsync<span class="ne-text"> <span class="ne-text">中初始化组件后。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></li>
<li id="u8d574e54" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">当父组件重新呈现并提供以下内容时：</span></li>
</ul>
<ul class="ne-list-wrap">
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="u898e2ce6" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">至少一个参数已更改时的已知或基元不可变类型。</span></li>
<li id="u466bee5e" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">复杂类型的参数。 框架无法知道复杂类型参数的值是否在内部发生了改变，因此，如果存在一个或多个复杂类型的参数，框架始终将参数集视为已更改。</span></li>
</ul>
</ul>
<div class="ne-quote">
<p id="u13b1f979" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">在组件路由中，不能同时对<span class="ne-text">DateTime<span class="ne-text">参数使用<code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">datetime</span></code><span class="ne-text">路由约束，并将该参数设为可选。 因此，以下 <code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">OnParamsSet</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 组件使用两个 <span class="ne-text">@page<span class="ne-text"> 指令来处理具有和没有 URL 中提供的日期段的路由。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
</div>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>@page "/on-params-set"
@page "/on-params-set/{StartDate:datetime}"

&lt;PageTitle&gt;On Parameters Set&lt;/PageTitle&gt;

&lt;h1&gt;On Parameters Set Example&lt;/h1&gt;

&lt;p&gt;
    Pass a datetime in the URI of the browser's address bar. 
    For example, add &lt;code&gt;/1-1-2024&lt;/code&gt; to the address.
&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;@message&lt;/p&gt;

@code {
    private string? message;

    [Parameter]
    public DateTime StartDate { get; set; }

    protected override void OnParametersSet()
    {
        if (StartDate == default)
        {
            StartDate = DateTime.Now;

            message = $"No start date in URL. Default value applied " +
                $"(StartDate: {StartDate}).";
        }
        else
        {
            message = $"The start date in the URL was used " +
                $"(StartDate: {StartDate}).";
        }
    }
}</code></pre>
<p id="u463d6cf5" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">应用参数和属性值时，异步操作必须在 <span class="ne-text">OnParametersSetAsync<span class="ne-text"> 生命周期事件期间发生：</span></span></span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>protected override async Task OnParametersSetAsync()
{
    await ...
}</code></pre>
<p id="ua1e95b53" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">如果自定义<span class="ne-text">基类<span class="ne-text">与自定义初始化逻辑一起使用，需在基类上调用 <span class="ne-text">OnParametersSetAsync<span class="ne-text">：</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>protected override async Task OnParametersSetAsync()
{
    await ...

    await base.OnParametersSetAsync();
}</code></pre>
<h4><span class="ne-text">组件呈现之后 (<code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text"><span class="ne-text">OnAfterRender<span class="ne-text"> 和 <span class="ne-text">OnAfterRenderAsync<span class="ne-text"> 在组件以交互方式呈现并且 UI 完成更新之后被调用（例如，元素添加到浏览器 DOM 之后）。 此时会填充元素和组件引用。 在此阶段中，可使用呈现的内容执行其他初始化步骤，例如与呈现的 DOM 元素交互的 JS 互操作调用。</span></span></span></span></span></code></span></h4>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p id="u3fae4eaf" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">这些方法不会在预呈现或静态服务器端渲染（静态 SSR）期间在服务器上调用，因为这些进程未附加到实时浏览器 DOM，并且已在 DOM 更新之前完成。</span></p>
<p id="u37b34d7c" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">对于<span class="ne-text"> <span class="ne-text">OnAfterRenderAsync<span class="ne-text">，组件在任何返回<span class="ne-text"> <code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">Task</span></code><span class="ne-text"> <span class="ne-text">的操作完成后不会自动重渲染，以避免无限渲染循环。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p id="u8043ef69" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">firstRender</span></code><span class="ne-text"> <span class="ne-text">和<span class="ne-text"> <span class="ne-text">OnAfterRender<span class="ne-text"> <span class="ne-text">的<span class="ne-text"> <span class="ne-text">OnAfterRenderAsync<span class="ne-text"> <span class="ne-text">参数：</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="u96d87764" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">在第一次呈现组件实例时设置为<span class="ne-text"> <code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">true</span></code><span class="ne-text">。</span></span></span></li>
<li id="u56870a83" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">可用于确保初始化操作仅执行一次。</span></li>
</ul>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>@page "/after-render"
@inject ILogger&lt;AfterRender&gt; Logger 

&lt;PageTitle&gt;After Render&lt;/PageTitle&gt;

&lt;h1&gt;After Render Example&lt;/h1&gt;

&lt;p&gt;
    &lt;button @onclick="HandleClick"&gt;Log information (and trigger a render)&lt;/button&gt;
&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Study logged messages in the console.&lt;/p&gt;

@code {
    protected override void OnAfterRender(bool firstRender) =&gt;
        Logger.LogInformation("firstRender = {FirstRender}", firstRender);

    private void HandleClick() =&gt; Logger.LogInformation("HandleClick called");
}</code></pre>
<p id="u2c27aa73" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">加载页面并选择按钮时，<code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">AfterRender.razor</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 示例向控制台输出以下内容：</span></span></p>
<p id="u7727f7f3" class="ne-p"><img src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2025/png/61146596/1760407678462-2bc28ee1-a6b9-47f1-ac4d-4d5d7e26effa.png" width="308" id="u83c8854e" class="ne-image" title=""></p>
<p id="u54ba717e" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">在渲染后立即进行的异步工作必须在 <span class="ne-text">OnAfterRenderAsync<span class="ne-text"> 生命周期事件期间发生：</span></span></span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>protected override async Task OnAfterRenderAsync(bool firstRender)
{
    ...
}</code></pre>
<p id="u7258e17f" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">如果自定义<span class="ne-text">基类<span class="ne-text">与自定义初始化逻辑一起使用，需在基类上调用 <span class="ne-text">OnAfterRenderAsync<span class="ne-text">：</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>protected override async Task OnAfterRenderAsync(bool firstRender)
{
    ...

    await base.OnAfterRenderAsync(firstRender);
}</code></pre>
<h4 id="DkkS8"><span class="ne-text">基类生命周期方法</span></h4>
<p id="ua6e67f30" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">重写 Blazor 的生命周期方法时，无需为<span class="ne-text"> <span class="ne-text">ComponentBase<span class="ne-text"> <span class="ne-text">调用基类生命周期方法。 但在以下情况下，组件应调用重写的基类生命周期方法：</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="u0b6fdbdb" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">重写<span class="ne-text"> <span class="ne-text">ComponentBase.SetParametersAsync<span class="ne-text"> <span class="ne-text">时，通常会调用<span class="ne-text"> <code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">await base.SetParametersAsync(parameters);</span></code><span class="ne-text">, 因为基类方法会调用其他生命周期方法并以复杂的方式触发渲染。 有关详细信息，请参阅<span class="ne-text">设置参数时 (SetParametersAsync)<span class="ne-text"> <span class="ne-text">部分。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></li>
<li id="u572743fe" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">如果基类方法包含必须执行的逻辑。 库使用者通常在继承基类时调用基类生命周期方法，因为库基类通常具有要执行的自定义生命周期逻辑。 如果应用使用某个库中的基类，请参阅该库的文档以获取指导。</span></li>
</ul>
<p id="u56f43ee8" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">以下示例中调用了 <code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">base.OnInitialized();</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 以确保会执行基类的 <code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">OnInitialized</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 方法。 如果没有调用，<code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">BlazorRocksBase2.OnInitialized</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 不会执行。</span></span></span></span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>@page "/blazor-rocks-2"
@inherits BlazorRocksBase2
@inject ILogger&lt;BlazorRocks2&gt; Logger

&lt;PageTitle&gt;Blazor Rocks!&lt;/PageTitle&gt;

&lt;h1&gt;Blazor Rocks! Example 2&lt;/h1&gt;

&lt;p&gt;
    @BlazorRocksText
&lt;/p&gt;

@code {
    protected override void OnInitialized()
    {
        Logger.LogInformation("Initialization code of BlazorRocks2 executed!");

        base.OnInitialized();
    }
}</code></pre>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components;

namespace BlazorAppWasm
{
    public class BlazorRocksBase2: ComponentBase
    {
        [Inject]
        private ILogger&lt;BlazorRocksBase2&gt; Logger { get; set; } = default!;

        public string BlazorRocksText { get; set; } = "Blazor rocks the browser!";

        protected override void OnInitialized() =&gt;
            Logger.LogInformation("Initialization code of BlazorRocksBase2 executed!");
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="VUbyF"><span class="ne-text">2、数据绑定</span></h2>
<p id="u4026738b" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">Blazor提供了强大的数据绑定机制，主要包括<strong><span class="ne-text">单向绑定</span></strong><span class="ne-text">和<strong><span class="ne-text">双向绑定</span></strong><span class="ne-text">两种模式。</span></span></span></p>
<h3 id="uFdnF"><span class="ne-text">1. 单向数据绑定</span></h3>
<p id="u73e440f2" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">单向绑定是指数据从组件流向UI，但UI的变化不会自动更新数据源。</span></p>
<p id="u0a4d8bd2" class="ne-p"><strong><span class="ne-text">基本语法</span></strong></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>&lt;!-- 使用 @ 符号进行单向绑定 --&gt;
&lt;p&gt;当前值: @currentValue&lt;/p&gt;
&lt;span&gt;用户名: @UserName&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;div&gt;创建时间: @CreateTime.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd")&lt;/div&gt;</code></pre>
<p id="u07a40a8d" class="ne-p"><strong>完整示例</strong></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>&lt;!-- OneWayBinding.razor --&gt;
&lt;div class="one-way-demo"&gt;
    &lt;h3&gt;单向绑定示例&lt;/h3&gt;
    
    &lt;!-- 显示数据，但不允许编辑 --&gt;
    &lt;div class="display-area"&gt;
        &lt;p&gt;计数器: &lt;strong&gt;@count&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
        &lt;p&gt;消息: &lt;strong&gt;@message&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
        &lt;p&gt;用户信息: &lt;strong&gt;@user.Name&lt;/strong&gt; - &lt;strong&gt;@user.Age&lt;/strong&gt;岁&lt;/p&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;

    &lt;!-- 控制按钮 --&gt;
    &lt;div class="control-area"&gt;
        &lt;button @onclick="Increment" class="btn btn-primary"&gt;增加计数&lt;/button&gt;
        &lt;button @onclick="ChangeMessage" class="btn btn-secondary"&gt;更改消息&lt;/button&gt;
        &lt;button @onclick="UpdateUser" class="btn btn-info"&gt;更新用户&lt;/button&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;
&lt;/div&gt;

@code {
    private int count = 0;
    private string message = "初始消息";
    private User user = new User { Name = "张三", Age = 25 };

    private void Increment()
    {
        count++;
        // StateHasChanged(); // 通常不需要手动调用，事件处理会自动触发重新渲染
    }

    private void ChangeMessage()
    {
        message = $"消息已更新: {DateTime.Now:HH:mm:ss}";
    }

    private void UpdateUser()
    {
        user = new User { Name = "李四", Age = 30 };
    }

    class User
    {
        public string Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public int Age { get; set; }
    }
}</code></pre>
<h3 id="wlQX5"><span class="ne-text">2. 双向数据绑定</span></h3>
<p id="ub1d8ea63" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">双向绑定允许数据在组件和UI之间双向流动：UI变化自动更新数据源，数据源变化自动更新UI。</span></p>
<p id="u73038b1f" class="ne-p"><strong><span class="ne-text">基本语法</span></strong></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>&lt;!-- 使用 @bind 指令进行双向绑定 --&gt;
&lt;input @bind="propertyName" /&gt;
&lt;input @bind="fieldName" /&gt;
&lt;select @bind="selectedValue"&gt;...&lt;/select&gt;</code></pre>
<p id="u59938824" class="ne-p"><strong><span class="ne-text">完整示例</span></strong></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>&lt;!-- TwoWayBinding.razor --&gt;
&lt;div class="two-way-demo"&gt;
    &lt;h3&gt;双向绑定示例&lt;/h3&gt;
    
    &lt;div class="form-group"&gt;
        &lt;label&gt;用户名:&lt;/label&gt;
        &lt;input @bind="userName" class="form-control" /&gt;
        &lt;small&gt;显示: @userName&lt;/small&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;

    &lt;div class="form-group"&gt;
        &lt;label&gt;邮箱:&lt;/label&gt;
        &lt;input @bind="email" class="form-control" /&gt;
        &lt;small&gt;显示: @email&lt;/small&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;

    &lt;div class="form-group"&gt;
        &lt;label&gt;年龄:&lt;/label&gt;
        &lt;input @bind="age" type="number" class="form-control" /&gt;
        &lt;small&gt;显示: @age&lt;/small&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;

    &lt;div class="form-group"&gt;
        &lt;label&gt;城市:&lt;/label&gt;
        &lt;select @bind="selectedCity" class="form-control"&gt;
            &lt;option value=""&gt;请选择&lt;/option&gt;
            &lt;option value="Beijing"&gt;北京&lt;/option&gt;
            &lt;option value="Shanghai"&gt;上海&lt;/option&gt;
            &lt;option value="Guangzhou"&gt;广州&lt;/option&gt;
            &lt;option value="Shenzhen"&gt;深圳&lt;/option&gt;
        &lt;/select&gt;
        &lt;small&gt;选择: @selectedCity&lt;/small&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;

    &lt;div class="form-group"&gt;
        &lt;label&gt;是否同意协议:&lt;/label&gt;
        &lt;input type="checkbox" @bind="isAgreed" /&gt;
        &lt;span&gt;@(isAgreed ? "已同意" : "未同意")&lt;/span&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;

    &lt;!-- 显示汇总信息 --&gt;
    &lt;div class="summary"&gt;
        &lt;h4&gt;汇总信息:&lt;/h4&gt;
        &lt;p&gt;用户名: @userName&lt;/p&gt;
        &lt;p&gt;邮箱: @email&lt;/p&gt;
        &lt;p&gt;年龄: @age&lt;/p&gt;
        &lt;p&gt;城市: @selectedCity&lt;/p&gt;
        &lt;p&gt;同意协议: @isAgreed&lt;/p&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;
&lt;/div&gt;

@code {
    private string userName = string.Empty;
    private string email = string.Empty;
    private int age = 0;
    private string selectedCity = string.Empty;
    private bool isAgreed = false;
}</code></pre>
<h3 id="Zz7o6"><span class="ne-text">3. 绑定事件控制</span></h3>
<h4 id="akXES"><span class="ne-text">3.1 绑定特定事件</span></h4>
<p id="u6e8dc751" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">默认情况下，<code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">@bind</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 在失去焦点时更新。可以使用 <code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">@bind:event</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 指定触发事件：</span></span></span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>&lt;!-- 实时绑定（输入时立即更新） --&gt;
&lt;div class="real-time-demo"&gt;
    &lt;h4&gt;实时绑定示例&lt;/h4&gt;
    
    &lt;input @bind="searchText" @bind:event="oninput" 
           placeholder="输入搜索内容..." /&gt;
    &lt;p&gt;实时搜索: @searchText&lt;/p&gt;

    &lt;!-- 对比默认行为 --&gt;
    &lt;input @bind="normalText" placeholder="默认绑定（失去焦点更新）" /&gt;
    &lt;p&gt;默认绑定: @normalText&lt;/p&gt;
&lt;/div&gt;

@code {
    private string searchText = string.Empty;
    private string normalText = string.Empty;
}</code></pre>
<h4 id="DdCbx"><span class="ne-text">3.2 绑定格式化</span></h4>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>&lt;div class="format-demo"&gt;
    &lt;h4&gt;格式化绑定示例&lt;/h4&gt;
    
    &lt;!-- 日期格式化 --&gt;
    &lt;input @bind="startDate" @bind:format="yyyy-MM-dd" type="date" /&gt;
    &lt;p&gt;选择的日期: @startDate.ToString("yyyy年MM月dd日")&lt;/p&gt;

    &lt;!-- 数字格式化 --&gt;
    &lt;input @bind="price" @bind:format="F2" type="number" step="0.01" /&gt;
    &lt;p&gt;价格: @price.ToString("C")&lt;/p&gt;
&lt;/div&gt;

@code {
    private DateTime startDate = DateTime.Today;
    private decimal price = 0.00m;
}</code></pre>
<h3 id="Tx3OX"><span class="ne-text">4. 自定义组件双向绑定</span></h3>
<p id="u1c0968fb" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">在自定义组件中实现双向绑定：</span></p>
<h4 id="zyzGk"><span class="ne-text">子组件</span></h4>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>&lt;!-- CustomInput.razor --&gt;
&lt;div class="custom-input"&gt;
    &lt;label&gt;@Label&lt;/label&gt;
    &lt;input 
        value="@Value" 
        @oninput="HandleInput"
        class="form-control @AdditionalClass"
        placeholder="@Placeholder" /&gt;
    @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(ValidationMessage))
    {
        &lt;div class="text-danger"&gt;@ValidationMessage&lt;/div&gt;
    }
&lt;/div&gt;

@code {
    [Parameter]
    public string Value { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    [Parameter]
    public EventCallback&lt;string&gt; ValueChanged { get; set; }

    [Parameter]
    public string Label { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    [Parameter]
    public string Placeholder { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    [Parameter]
    public string AdditionalClass { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    [Parameter]
    public string ValidationMessage { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    private async Task HandleInput(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        Value = e.Value?.ToString() ?? string.Empty;
        await ValueChanged.InvokeAsync(Value);
    }
}</code></pre>
<h4 id="QS2mw"><span class="ne-text">父组件使用</span></h4>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>&lt;!-- ParentComponent.razor --&gt;
&lt;div class="parent-demo"&gt;
    &lt;h3&gt;自定义组件双向绑定&lt;/h3&gt;
    
    &lt;CustomInput 
        @bind-Value="userName" 
        Label="用户名" 
        Placeholder="请输入用户名" /&gt;

    &lt;CustomInput 
        @bind-Value="email" 
        Label="邮箱" 
        Placeholder="请输入邮箱地址"
        ValidationMessage="@(IsValidEmail ? "" : "邮箱格式不正确")" /&gt;

    &lt;div class="result"&gt;
        &lt;p&gt;用户名: @userName&lt;/p&gt;
        &lt;p&gt;邮箱: @email&lt;/p&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;
&lt;/div&gt;

@code {
    private string userName = string.Empty;
    private string email = string.Empty;

    private bool IsValidEmail =&gt; email.Contains("@") &amp;&amp; email.Contains(".");
}</code></pre>
<h3 id="C2dYT"><span class="ne-text">5.复杂对象绑定</span></h3>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>&lt;!-- ComplexObjectBinding.razor --&gt;
&lt;div class="complex-binding"&gt;
    &lt;h3&gt;复杂对象绑定&lt;/h3&gt;
    
    &lt;div class="form-section"&gt;
        &lt;h4&gt;用户信息&lt;/h4&gt;
        
        &lt;div class="form-group"&gt;
            &lt;label&gt;姓名:&lt;/label&gt;
            &lt;input @bind="currentUser.Name" class="form-control" /&gt;
        &lt;/div&gt;

        &lt;div class="form-group"&gt;
            &lt;label&gt;年龄:&lt;/label&gt;
            &lt;input @bind="currentUser.Age" type="number" class="form-control" /&gt;
        &lt;/div&gt;

        &lt;div class="form-group"&gt;
            &lt;label&gt;地址:&lt;/label&gt;
            &lt;input @bind="currentUser.Address.Street" class="form-control" placeholder="街道" /&gt;
            &lt;input @bind="currentUser.Address.City" class="form-control" placeholder="城市" /&gt;
        &lt;/div&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;

    &lt;div class="display-section"&gt;
        &lt;h4&gt;当前用户信息:&lt;/h4&gt;
        &lt;pre&gt;@userInfoJson&lt;/pre&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;

    &lt;button @onclick="ResetUser" class="btn btn-warning"&gt;重置用户&lt;/button&gt;
    &lt;button @onclick="CreateNewUser" class="btn btn-success"&gt;创建新用户&lt;/button&gt;
&lt;/div&gt;

@code {
    private User currentUser = new User();

    private string userInfoJson =&gt; 
        System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(currentUser, new System.Text.Json.JsonSerializerOptions 
        { 
            WriteIndented = true 
        });

    private void ResetUser()
    {
        currentUser = new User();
    }

    private void CreateNewUser()
    {
        currentUser = new User
        {
            Name = "新用户",
            Age = 18,
            Address = new Address { Street = "新建街道", City = "新建城市" }
        };
    }

    class User
    {
        public string Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public int Age { get; set; }
        public Address Address { get; set; } = new Address();
    }

    class Address
    {
        public string Street { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public string City { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    }
}</code></pre>

<h2 id="SMCXE"><span class="ne-text">3、事件处理</span></h2>
<h3 id="FU9It"><span class="ne-text">1. 基本事件处理</span></h3>
<h4 id="EXiBf"><span class="ne-text">1.1 单击事件</span></h4>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>&lt;!-- ClickEvents.razor --&gt;
&lt;div class="click-demo"&gt;
    &lt;h3&gt;单击事件示例&lt;/h3&gt;
    
    &lt;!-- 基本点击事件 --&gt;
    &lt;button @onclick="HandleClick" class="btn btn-primary"&gt;
        点击我
    &lt;/button&gt;

    &lt;!-- 带参数的事件处理 --&gt;
    &lt;div class="button-group"&gt;
        &lt;button @onclick="() =&gt; HandleButtonClick(1)" class="btn btn-secondary"&gt;按钮 1&lt;/button&gt;
        &lt;button @onclick="() =&gt; HandleButtonClick(2)" class="btn btn-secondary"&gt;按钮 2&lt;/button&gt;
        &lt;button @onclick="() =&gt; HandleButtonClick(3)" class="btn btn-secondary"&gt;按钮 3&lt;/button&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;

    &lt;!-- 显示点击结果 --&gt;
    &lt;div class="result"&gt;
        &lt;p&gt;最后点击的按钮: @lastClickedButton&lt;/p&gt;
        &lt;p&gt;点击次数: @clickCount&lt;/p&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;
&lt;/div&gt;

@code {
    private int lastClickedButton = 0;
    private int clickCount = 0;

    private void HandleClick()
    {
        clickCount++;
        Console.WriteLine("按钮被点击了！");
    }

    private void HandleButtonClick(int buttonNumber)
    {
        lastClickedButton = buttonNumber;
        clickCount++;
        StateHasChanged();
    }
}</code></pre>
<h4 id="n55dB"><span class="ne-text">1.2 异步事件处理</span></h4>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>&lt;!-- AsyncEvents.razor --&gt;
&lt;div class="async-demo"&gt;
    &lt;h3&gt;异步事件处理&lt;/h3&gt;
    
    &lt;button @onclick="HandleAsyncClick" class="btn btn-primary" disabled="@isLoading"&gt;
        @if (isLoading)
        {
            &lt;span&gt;加载中...&lt;/span&gt;
        }
        else
        {
            &lt;span&gt;模拟异步操作&lt;/span&gt;
        }
    &lt;/button&gt;

    &lt;div class="result"&gt;
        &lt;p&gt;操作结果: @operationResult&lt;/p&gt;
        &lt;p&gt;耗时: @elapsedTime 毫秒&lt;/p&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;
&lt;/div&gt;

@code {
    private bool isLoading = false;
    private string operationResult = string.Empty;
    private long elapsedTime = 0;

    private async Task HandleAsyncClick()
    {
        isLoading = true;
        operationResult = "操作开始...";
        
        var stopwatch = System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.StartNew();
        
        // 模拟异步操作
        await Task.Delay(2000);
        
        stopwatch.Stop();
        elapsedTime = stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds;
        
        operationResult = $"操作完成！数据已保存。";
        isLoading = false;
        
        StateHasChanged();
    }
}</code></pre>
<h3 id="JLfh3"><span class="ne-text">2. 表单事件处理</span></h3>
<h4 id="YbriP"><span class="ne-text">2.1 输入事件</span></h4>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>&lt;!-- FormEvents.razor --&gt;
&lt;div class="form-events"&gt;
    &lt;h3&gt;表单事件处理&lt;/h3&gt;
    
    &lt;div class="form-group"&gt;
        &lt;label&gt;输入文本:&lt;/label&gt;
        &lt;input @oninput="HandleInput" 
               @onchange="HandleChange"
               class="form-control" 
               placeholder="输入内容..." /&gt;
        &lt;small&gt;实时输入: @inputValue | 变化事件: @changeValue&lt;/small&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;

    &lt;div class="form-group"&gt;
        &lt;label&gt;选择选项:&lt;/label&gt;
        &lt;select @onchange="HandleSelectChange" class="form-control"&gt;
            &lt;option value=""&gt;请选择&lt;/option&gt;
            &lt;option value="option1"&gt;选项一&lt;/option&gt;
            &lt;option value="option2"&gt;选项二&lt;/option&gt;
            &lt;option value="option3"&gt;选项三&lt;/option&gt;
        &lt;/select&gt;
        &lt;small&gt;选择的值: @selectedValue&lt;/small&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;

    &lt;div class="form-group"&gt;
        &lt;label&gt;
            &lt;input type="checkbox" @onchange="HandleCheckboxChange" /&gt;
            同意条款
        &lt;/label&gt;
        &lt;small&gt;状态: @(isChecked ? "已选中" : "未选中")&lt;/small&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;

    &lt;!-- 表单提交 --&gt;
    &lt;form @onsubmit="HandleSubmit" @onvalidSubmit="HandleValidSubmit"&gt;
        &lt;div class="form-group"&gt;
            &lt;label&gt;用户名:&lt;/label&gt;
            &lt;input @bind="user.Username" class="form-control" required /&gt;
        &lt;/div&gt;
        
        &lt;div class="form-group"&gt;
            &lt;label&gt;邮箱:&lt;/label&gt;
            &lt;input @bind="user.Email" type="email" class="form-control" required /&gt;
        &lt;/div&gt;
        
        &lt;button type="submit" class="btn btn-success"&gt;提交表单&lt;/button&gt;
    &lt;/form&gt;

    &lt;div class="form-result"&gt;
        &lt;h4&gt;表单数据:&lt;/h4&gt;
        &lt;pre&gt;@System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(user, new System.Text.Json.JsonSerializerOptions { WriteIndented = true })&lt;/pre&gt;
        &lt;p&gt;提交状态: @submitStatus&lt;/p&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;
&lt;/div&gt;

@code {
    private string inputValue = string.Empty;
    private string changeValue = string.Empty;
    private string selectedValue = string.Empty;
    private bool isChecked = false;
    private string submitStatus = "未提交";
    
    private User user = new User();

    private void HandleInput(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        inputValue = e.Value?.ToString() ?? string.Empty;
    }

    private void HandleChange(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        changeValue = e.Value?.ToString() ?? string.Empty;
    }

    private void HandleSelectChange(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        selectedValue = e.Value?.ToString() ?? string.Empty;
    }

    private void HandleCheckboxChange(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        isChecked = (bool)(e.Value ?? false);
    }

    private void HandleSubmit()
    {
        submitStatus = "表单提交（可能有验证错误）";
    }

    private void HandleValidSubmit()
    {
        submitStatus = $"表单验证通过！数据已保存 - {DateTime.Now:HH:mm:ss}";
        // 这里可以调用API保存数据
    }

    class User
    {
        public string Username { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public string Email { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    }
}</code></pre>
<h3 id="XU9VU"><span class="ne-text">3. 鼠标和键盘事件</span></h3>
<h4 id="HeK1T"><span class="ne-text">3.1 鼠标事件</span></h4>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>&lt;!-- MouseEvents.razor --&gt;
&lt;div class="mouse-events"&gt;
    &lt;h3&gt;鼠标事件&lt;/h3&gt;
    
    &lt;div class="interactive-area"
         @onmousedown="HandleMouseDown"
         @onmouseup="HandleMouseUp"
         @onmousemove="HandleMouseMove"
         @onmouseover="HandleMouseOver"
         @onmouseout="HandleMouseOut"
         @onclick="HandleAreaClick"
         @ondblclick="HandleDoubleClick"
         style="width: 300px; height: 200px; border: 2px solid #007bff; padding: 20px; margin: 10px 0;"&gt;
        鼠标交互区域
    &lt;/div&gt;

    &lt;div class="event-log"&gt;
        &lt;h4&gt;事件日志:&lt;/h4&gt;
        &lt;ul&gt;
            @foreach (var log in eventLogs.TakeLast(10).Reverse())
            {
                &lt;li&gt;@log&lt;/li&gt;
            }
        &lt;/ul&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;

    &lt;div class="mouse-info"&gt;
        &lt;p&gt;鼠标位置: (@mouseX, @mouseY)&lt;/p&gt;
        &lt;p&gt;按钮状态: @(isMouseDown ? "按下" : "释放")&lt;/p&gt;
        &lt;p&gt;悬停状态: @(isMouseOver ? "在区域内" : "在区域外")&lt;/p&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;
&lt;/div&gt;

@code {
    private double mouseX = 0;
    private double mouseY = 0;
    private bool isMouseDown = false;
    private bool isMouseOver = false;
    private List&lt;string&gt; eventLogs = new List&lt;string&gt;();

    private void LogEvent(string eventName)
    {
        eventLogs.Add($"{DateTime.Now:HH:mm:ss.fff} - {eventName}");
        StateHasChanged();
    }

    private void HandleMouseDown(MouseEventArgs e)
    {
        isMouseDown = true;
        LogEvent($"MouseDown - 按钮: {e.Button}, 位置: ({e.ClientX}, {e.ClientY})");
    }

    private void HandleMouseUp(MouseEventArgs e)
    {
        isMouseDown = false;
        LogEvent($"MouseUp - 按钮: {e.Button}, 位置: ({e.ClientX}, {e.ClientY})");
    }

    private void HandleMouseMove(MouseEventArgs e)
    {
        mouseX = e.ClientX;
        mouseY = e.ClientY;
        // 注意：频繁触发，生产环境需要节流
        // LogEvent($"MouseMove - 位置: ({e.ClientX}, {e.ClientY})");
    }

    private void HandleMouseOver(MouseEventArgs e)
    {
        isMouseOver = true;
        LogEvent("MouseOver");
    }

    private void HandleMouseOut(MouseEventArgs e)
    {
        isMouseOver = false;
        LogEvent("MouseOut");
    }

    private void HandleAreaClick(MouseEventArgs e)
    {
        LogEvent($"Click - 按钮: {e.Button}");
    }

    private void HandleDoubleClick(MouseEventArgs e)
    {
        LogEvent($"DoubleClick - 按钮: {e.Button}");
    }
}</code></pre>
<h4 id="oEkWq"><span class="ne-text">3.2 键盘事件</span></h4>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>&lt;!-- KeyboardEvents.razor --&gt;
&lt;div class="keyboard-events"&gt;
    &lt;h3&gt;键盘事件&lt;/h3&gt;
    
    &lt;div class="input-area"&gt;
        &lt;input @onkeydown="HandleKeyDown"
               @onkeyup="HandleKeyUp"
               @onkeypress="HandleKeyPress"
               class="form-control"
               placeholder="在这里输入并观察键盘事件..." /&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;

    &lt;div class="event-log"&gt;
        &lt;h4&gt;键盘事件日志:&lt;/h4&gt;
        &lt;ul&gt;
            @foreach (var log in keyEventLogs.TakeLast(10).Reverse())
            {
                &lt;li&gt;@log&lt;/li&gt;
            }
        &lt;/ul&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;

    &lt;div class="key-info"&gt;
        &lt;p&gt;最后按下的键: @lastKey&lt;/p&gt;
        &lt;p&gt;Ctrl 按下: @(isCtrlPressed ? "是" : "否")&lt;/p&gt;
        &lt;p&gt;Shift 按下: @(isShiftPressed ? "是" : "否")&lt;/p&gt;
        &lt;p&gt;Alt 按下: @(isAltPressed ? "是" : "否")&lt;/p&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;
&lt;/div&gt;

@code {
    private string lastKey = "无";
    private bool isCtrlPressed = false;
    private bool isShiftPressed = false;
    private bool isAltPressed = false;
    private List&lt;string&gt; keyEventLogs = new List&lt;string&gt;();

    private void LogKeyEvent(string eventName, KeyboardEventArgs e)
    {
        var log = $"{DateTime.Now:HH:mm:ss.fff} - {eventName}: Key='{e.Key}', Code='{e.Code}'";
        if (e.CtrlKey) log += " [Ctrl]";
        if (e.ShiftKey) log += " [Shift]";
        if (e.AltKey) log += " [Alt]";
        
        keyEventLogs.Add(log);
        StateHasChanged();
    }

    private void HandleKeyDown(KeyboardEventArgs e)
    {
        lastKey = e.Key;
        isCtrlPressed = e.CtrlKey;
        isShiftPressed = e.ShiftKey;
        isAltPressed = e.AltKey;
        
        LogKeyEvent("KeyDown", e);

        // 快捷键处理示例
        if (e.CtrlKey &amp;&amp; e.Key == "s")
        {
            e.PreventDefault(); // 阻止浏览器默认保存行为
            LogKeyEvent("快捷键: Ctrl+S", e);
        }
    }

    private void HandleKeyUp(KeyboardEventArgs e)
    {
        isCtrlPressed = e.CtrlKey;
        isShiftPressed = e.ShiftKey;
        isAltPressed = e.AltKey;
        
        LogKeyEvent("KeyUp", e);
    }

    private void HandleKeyPress(KeyboardEventArgs e)
    {
        LogKeyEvent("KeyPress", e);
    }
}</code></pre>
<h3 id="lYKlx"><span class="ne-text">4. 焦点和剪贴板事件</span></h3>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>&lt;!-- FocusClipboardEvents.razor --&gt;
&lt;div class="focus-clipboard"&gt;
    &lt;h3&gt;焦点和剪贴板事件&lt;/h3&gt;
    
    &lt;div class="form-group"&gt;
        &lt;label&gt;焦点测试输入框:&lt;/label&gt;
        &lt;input @onfocus="HandleFocus"
               @onblur="HandleBlur"
               class="form-control"
               placeholder="点击获取焦点，点击别处失去焦点" /&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;

    &lt;div class="form-group"&gt;
        &lt;label&gt;复制粘贴测试:&lt;/label&gt;
        &lt;textarea @oncopy="HandleCopy"
                  @oncut="HandleCut"
                  @onpaste="HandlePaste"
                  class="form-control"
                  rows="3"
                  placeholder="在这里测试复制、剪切、粘贴操作"&gt;这是一些测试文本&lt;/textarea&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;

    &lt;div class="event-log"&gt;
        &lt;h4&gt;事件状态:&lt;/h4&gt;
        &lt;p&gt;焦点状态: &lt;span class="@(hasFocus ? "text-success" : "text-danger")"&gt;@(hasFocus ? "有焦点" : "无焦点")&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
        &lt;p&gt;最后操作: @lastOperation&lt;/p&gt;
        &lt;p&gt;剪贴板内容: @clipboardContent&lt;/p&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;
&lt;/div&gt;

@code {
    private bool hasFocus = false;
    private string lastOperation = "无";
    private string clipboardContent = "无";

    private void HandleFocus(FocusEventArgs e)
    {
        hasFocus = true;
        lastOperation = "获得焦点";
        StateHasChanged();
    }

    private void HandleBlur(FocusEventArgs e)
    {
        hasFocus = false;
        lastOperation = "失去焦点";
        StateHasChanged();
    }

    private void HandleCopy(ClipboardEventArgs e)
    {
        lastOperation = "复制操作";
        clipboardContent = "复制的内容无法直接获取（安全限制）";
        StateHasChanged();
    }

    private void HandleCut(ClipboardEventArgs e)
    {
        lastOperation = "剪切操作";
        clipboardContent = "剪切的内容无法直接获取（安全限制）";
        StateHasChanged();
    }

    private void HandlePaste(ClipboardEventArgs e)
    {
        lastOperation = "粘贴操作";
        clipboardContent = "粘贴的内容无法直接获取（安全限制）";
        StateHasChanged();
    }
}</code></pre>
<h3 id="ZSwjZ"><span class="ne-text">5. 自定义事件处理</span></h3>
<h4 id="cwMLK"><span class="ne-text">5.1 事件参数封装</span></h4>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>&lt;!-- CustomEventHandling.razor --&gt;
&lt;div class="custom-events"&gt;
    &lt;h3&gt;自定义事件处理&lt;/h3&gt;
    
    &lt;!-- 事件冒泡和阻止默认行为 --&gt;
    &lt;div @onclick="HandleParentClick" style="padding: 20px; border: 2px solid red;"&gt;
        &lt;p&gt;父级区域（点击会触发）&lt;/p&gt;
        &lt;button @onclick="HandleChildClick" 
                @onclick:stopPropagation
                class="btn btn-primary"&gt;
            子按钮（点击不会冒泡）
        &lt;/button&gt;
        
        &lt;button @onclick="HandleChildClickWithPrevent" 
                @onclick:preventDefault
                class="btn btn-secondary"&gt;
            阻止默认行为的按钮
        &lt;/button&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;

    &lt;!-- 自定义事件处理逻辑 --&gt;
    &lt;div class="custom-actions"&gt;
        &lt;h4&gt;自定义操作:&lt;/h4&gt;
        &lt;button @onclick="HandleCustomAction1" class="btn btn-info"&gt;操作1&lt;/button&gt;
        &lt;button @onclick="HandleCustomAction2" class="btn btn-info"&gt;操作2&lt;/button&gt;
        &lt;button @onclick="async () =&gt; await HandleCustomAsyncAction()" class="btn btn-info"&gt;异步操作&lt;/button&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;

    &lt;div class="action-log"&gt;
        &lt;h4&gt;操作日志:&lt;/h4&gt;
        &lt;ul&gt;
            @foreach (var log in actionLogs.TakeLast(5).Reverse())
            {
                &lt;li&gt;@log&lt;/li&gt;
            }
        &lt;/ul&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;
&lt;/div&gt;

@code {
    private List&lt;string&gt; actionLogs = new List&lt;string&gt;();

    private void LogAction(string action)
    {
        actionLogs.Add($"{DateTime.Now:HH:mm:ss} - {action}");
        StateHasChanged();
    }

    private void HandleParentClick()
    {
        LogAction("父级区域被点击");
    }

    private void HandleChildClick()
    {
        LogAction("子按钮被点击（事件不会冒泡）");
    }

    private void HandleChildClickWithPrevent()
    {
        LogAction("阻止默认行为的按钮被点击");
    }

    private void HandleCustomAction1()
    {
        LogAction("执行自定义操作1");
        // 自定义业务逻辑
    }

    private void HandleCustomAction2(MouseEventArgs e)
    {
        LogAction($"执行自定义操作2 - 点击位置: ({e.ClientX}, {e.ClientY})");
        // 自定义业务逻辑
    }

    private async Task HandleCustomAsyncAction()
    {
        LogAction("开始异步操作");
        await Task.Delay(1000);
        LogAction("异步操作完成");
    }
}</code></pre>
<h3 id="HhcWp"><span class="ne-text">6. 事件处理最佳实践</span></h3>
<h4 id="Bx8DZ"><span class="ne-text">6.1 性能优化</span></h4>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>&lt;!-- OptimizedEvents.razor --&gt;
&lt;div class="optimized-events"&gt;
    &lt;h3&gt;事件处理性能优化&lt;/h3&gt;

    &lt;!-- 避免内联Lambda表达式（可能引起不必要的重渲染） --&gt;
    @foreach (var item in items)
    {
        &lt;div class="item" @key="item.Id"&gt;
            &lt;span&gt;@item.Name&lt;/span&gt;
            &lt;!-- 好的做法：使用方法引用 --&gt;
            &lt;button @onclick="() =&gt; DeleteItem(item.Id)" class="btn btn-sm btn-danger"&gt;删除&lt;/button&gt;
        &lt;/div&gt;
    }

    &lt;!-- 大量事件考虑使用事件委托 --&gt;
    &lt;div class="large-list"&gt;
        @foreach (var item in largeList)
        {
            &lt;div class="list-item" data-id="@item.Id" data-name="@item.Name" @onclick="(e) =&gt; HandleListItemClick(e, item.Id)"&gt;
                @item.Name
            &lt;/div&gt;
        }
    &lt;/div&gt;

    &lt;div class="action-log"&gt;
        &lt;h4&gt;操作日志:&lt;/h4&gt;
        &lt;ul&gt;
            @foreach (var log in actionLogs.TakeLast(5).Reverse())
            {
                &lt;li&gt;@log&lt;/li&gt;
            }
        &lt;/ul&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;
&lt;/div&gt;

@code {
    private List&lt;Item&gt; items = new List&lt;Item&gt;
    {
        new Item { Id = 1, Name = "项目1" },
        new Item { Id = 2, Name = "项目2" },
        new Item { Id = 3, Name = "项目3" }
    };

    private List&lt;Item&gt; largeList = Enumerable.Range(1, 100)
        .Select(i =&gt; new Item { Id = i, Name = $"项目{i}" })
        .ToList();

    private List&lt;string&gt; actionLogs = new List&lt;string&gt;();

    private void DeleteItem(int id)
    {
        items.RemoveAll(i =&gt; i.Id == id);
        LogAction($"删除了项目 {id}");
    }

    private void HandleListItemClick(MouseEventArgs e, int itemId)
    {
        // 通过参数 itemId 就知道是哪个按钮被点击了
        Console.WriteLine($"Clicked item ID: {itemId}");
    }

    // 添加 LogAction 方法
    private void LogAction(string action)
    {
        actionLogs.Add($"{DateTime.Now:HH:mm:ss} - {action}");
        StateHasChanged();
    }

    class Item
    {
        public int Id { get; set; }
        public string Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    }
}</code></pre>

</td>
<td width="187">
<p id="u1a128cc3" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">元素失去焦点</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="138">
<p id="u9140879b" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">表单提交</span></p>
</td>
<td width="187">
<p id="uc140b081" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">@onsubmit</span></code></p>
</td>
<td width="187">
<p id="u5f6a2377" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">EventArgs</span></code></p>
</td>
<td width="187">
<p id="ubded899a" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">表单提交</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h2 id="qPhDl"><span class="ne-text">4、组件参数和级联参数</span></h2>
<h3 id="d19e078d"><span class="ne-text">1. 组件参数(Parameter)</span></h3>
<p id="u7cbba928" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">参数主要用来在各组件之间传递值，在初始项目的SurveyPrompt组件中就包含了一个参数:</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>[Parameter]
public string Title { get; set; }</code></pre>
<p id="ubf0d79b9" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">通过用Parameter修饰符来修饰，就可以将指定的属性（注意要是public的）声明为参数，使用也很简单：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>&lt;SurveyPrompt Title="这里是参数的值" /&gt;</code></pre>
<h3 id="2.-captureunmatchedvalues"><span class="ne-text">2. CaptureUnmatchedValues</span></h3>
<p id="u4052b10c" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text"> 是 Blazor 中一个非常有用的特性，它允许组件捕获所有未匹配到组件参数的额外属性。</span></code></p>
<h4 id="Lft1N"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">基本概念</span></code></h4>
<p id="u43aa4933" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">当你在组件上设置了属性，但这些属性没有对应的 <code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text"> 时，<code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text"> 可以捕获这些"未匹配"的属性，而且修饰的属性必须要是字典类型：IDictionary&lt;string,object&gt;。</span></code></span></code></span></code></p>
<h4 id="KUxhE"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">基本用法</span></code></code></code></h4>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code>&lt;!-- MyComponent.razor --&gt;
&lt;div @attributes="AdditionalAttributes"&gt;
    组件内容
&lt;/div&gt;

@code {
    [Parameter(CaptureUnmatchedValues = true)]
    public Dictionary&lt;string, object&gt; AdditionalAttributes { get; set; } = 
        new Dictionary&lt;string, object&gt;();
}</code></code></code></code></pre>
<h4 id="G3WLT"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">使用场景示例</span></code></code></code></h4>
<h5 id="JV7CT"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">1. 创建可复用的按钮组件</span></code></code></code></h5>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code>&lt;!-- MyButton.razor --&gt;
&lt;button @attributes="AdditionalAttributes" class="btn @Class"&gt;
    @ChildContent
&lt;/button&gt;

@code {
    [Parameter]
    public string Class { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    
    [Parameter]
    public RenderFragment? ChildContent { get; set; }
    
    [Parameter(CaptureUnmatchedValues = true)]
    public Dictionary&lt;string, object&gt; AdditionalAttributes { get; set; } = 
        new Dictionary&lt;string, object&gt;();
}</code></code></code></code></pre>
<p id="uaaf105ba" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><strong><span class="ne-text">使用方式</span></strong></code></code></code></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code>&lt;MyButton class="btn-primary"
          id="submit-btn"
          onclick="console.log('clicked me')"
          data-custom="value"&gt;
    点击我
&lt;/MyButton&gt;</code></code></code></code></pre>
<h5 id="e7m3q"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">2.包装第三方组件</span></code></code></code></h5>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code>&lt;!-- WrapperComponent.razor --&gt;
&lt;ThirdPartyComponent @attributes="AdditionalAttributes" 
                     SpecificParameter="@SpecificValue" /&gt;

@code {
    [Parameter]
    public string SpecificValue { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    
    [Parameter(CaptureUnmatchedValues = true)]
    public Dictionary&lt;string, object&gt; AdditionalAttributes { get; set; } = 
        new Dictionary&lt;string, object&gt;();
}</code></code></code></code></pre>
<h4 id="uFxzl"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">实际应用案例</span></code></code></code></h4>
<h5 id="mFLbX"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">创建灵活的容器组件</span></code></code></code></h5>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code>&lt;!-- FlexContainer.razor --&gt;
&lt;div @attributes="AdditionalAttributes" class="flex-container @Class"&gt;
    @ChildContent
&lt;/div&gt;

@code {
    [Parameter]
    public string Class { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    
    [Parameter]
    public RenderFragment? ChildContent { get; set; }
    
    [Parameter(CaptureUnmatchedValues = true)]
    public Dictionary&lt;string, object&gt; AdditionalAttributes { get; set; } = 
        new Dictionary&lt;string, object&gt;();
}</code></code></code></code></pre>
<p id="u2c787929" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">使用示例:</span></code></code></code></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code>&lt;FlexContainer class="my-styles" 
               id="main-container"
               style=""
               data-tracking="user-section"
               aria-label="主要区域"&gt;
    &lt;p&gt;这里是可以自定义样式的容器内容&lt;/p&gt;
&lt;/FlexContainer&gt;</code></code></code></code></pre>
<h3 id="14736233"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">3. 级联参数(CascadingParameter)</span></code></code></code></h3>
<p id="uc0c7b69f" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">级联参数看起来就比Parameter更高级，主要用来在多级组件之间传递参数，听起来有点抽象，咱们举个栗子：</span></code></code></code></p>
<p id="ube6b0f9d" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">考虑以下三个组件的嵌套关系，如果想把一个参数同时传给CascComp1和CascComp2应该如何做呢？</span></code></code></code></p>
<p id="u510ceb1a" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><img src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2025/png/61146596/1760427397853-cedeb8e8-f239-45e8-907b-3da506449943.png" width="769" id="u1dc669c3" class="ne-image" title=""></code></code></code></p>
<h4 id="LvjS1"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">如果采用普通的Parameter，代码应该是这样的：</span></code></code></code></h4>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code>&lt;!--this is CascCompSample.razor--&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;This is the sample page&lt;/h3&gt;
&lt;CascComp1 NickName="沈先生"&gt;&lt;/CascComp1&gt;</code></code></code></code></pre>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code>&lt;!--this is CascComp1.razor--&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Comp1: @NickName&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;CascComp2 NickName="@NickName"&gt;&lt;/CascComp2&gt;
@code {
    [Parameter]
    public string NickName { get; set; }
}</code></code></code></code></pre>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code>&lt;!--this is CascComp2.razor--&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Comp2: @NickName&lt;/h3&gt;

@code {
    [Parameter]
    public string NickName { get; set; }
}</code></code></code></code></pre>
<h4 id="a91KC"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">采用CascadingParameter会有什么不一样呢？请看：</span></code></code></code></h4>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code>&lt;!--this is CascCompSample.razor--&gt;

@page "/cascparamsample"

&lt;h3&gt;This is the sample page&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;CascadingValue Value="NickName"&gt;
    &lt;CascComp1&gt;&lt;/CascComp1&gt;
&lt;/CascadingValue&gt;

@code
{
    private string NickName = "沈先生";
}</code></code></code></code></pre>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code>&lt;!--this is CascComp1.razor--&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Comp1: @NickName&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;CascComp2&gt;&lt;/CascComp2&gt;

@code {
    [CascadingParameter]
    public string NickName { get; set; }
}</code></code></code></code></pre>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code>&lt;!--this is CascComp2.razor--&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Comp2: @NickName&lt;/h3&gt;

@code {
    [CascadingParameter]
    public string NickName { get; set; }
}</code></code></code></code></pre>
<p id="u9c70c77c" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">看到区别了吗？</span></code></code></code></p>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="u6e1d29c0" data-lake-index-type="0"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">首先在CascCompSample.razor页面，我们通过把CascComp1嵌套到CascadingValue里面来传递参数。</span></code></code></code></li>
<li id="uae9b7d8d" data-lake-index-type="0"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">其次在CascComp1和CascComp2，不再需要显式传递参数，只需要声明CascadingParameter即可拿到值。</span></code></code></code></li>
</ul>
<div class="ne-quote">
<p id="u84442059" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><em><span class="ne-text">CascadingValue组件的Value参数不能直接传递字符串，必须要声明一个变量</span></em></code></code></code></p>
</div>
<p id="uc4565c8c" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">那么什么场景下需要用到这种方式呢？我想比较多的还是用来在多个组件之间共享上下文吧。</span></code></code></code></p>
<h3 id="97ea9f93"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">4. CascadingParameter如何传递多个参数</span></code></code></code></h3>
<p id="u108684c8" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">前面的例子我们通过CascadingParameter传递了一个参数，那么有没有办法传递多个参数呢？</span></code></code></code></p>
<p id="ued5861b1" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">当然可以，CascadingValue是支持嵌套的，你可以这样:</span></code></code></code></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code>&lt;!--this is CascCompSample.razor--&gt;

@page "/cascparamsample"

&lt;h3&gt;This is the sample page&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;CascadingValue Value="NickName"&gt;
    &lt;CascadingValue Value="36"&gt;
        &lt;CascComp1&gt;&lt;/CascComp1&gt;
    &lt;/CascadingValue&gt;
&lt;/CascadingValue&gt;

@code
{
    private string NickName = "沈先生";
}</code></code></code></code></pre>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code>&lt;!--this is CascComp1.razor--&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Comp1: @NickName - @Age&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;CascComp2&gt;&lt;/CascComp2&gt;

@code {
    [CascadingParameter]
    public string NickName { get; set; }
    [CascadingParameter]
    public int Age { get; set; }
}</code></code></code></code></pre>
<p id="u5c16f1fd" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">Blazor是通过参数的类型来关联的，在外层通过CascadingValue传递了一个字符串和一个整数，在里层则通过类型匹配将字符串赋值给NickName，将整数赋值给Age。所以里层的参数名是可以随便取的，你可以把NickName改为FullName，并不会影响参数值的获取。</span></code></code></code></p>
<p id="u462be132" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">这个方式虽然可以少写一些代码，但是容易出错，而且如果碰到多个同类型的参数就无法处理了，笔者并不建议用这种方式。</span></code></code></code></p>
<p id="u4a753662" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">除此之外，CascadingValue还有一个Name参数,可以给每个参数指定参数名，这样就可以显式的把各个组件的参数关联起来，笔者建议不管是一个参数还是多个参数都指定一个名字，这样可以尽量避免混淆，代码如下：</span></code></code></code></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code>&lt;!--this is CascCompSample.razor--&gt;

@page "/cascparamsample"

&lt;h3&gt;This is the sample page&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;CascadingValue Value="NickName" Name="NickName"&gt;
    &lt;CascadingValue Value="36" Name="Age"&gt;
        &lt;CascadingValue Value="Sex" Name="Sex"&gt;
            &lt;CascComp1&gt;&lt;/CascComp1&gt;
        &lt;/CascadingValue&gt;
    &lt;/CascadingValue&gt;
&lt;/CascadingValue&gt;

@code
{
    private string NickName = "沈先生";
}</code></code></code></code></pre>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code>&lt;!--this is CascComp1.razor--&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Comp1: @NickName  - @Sex - @Age&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;CascComp2&gt;&lt;/CascComp2&gt;

@code {
    [CascadingParameter(Name="NickName")]
    public string NickName { get; set; }
    [CascadingParameter(Name = "Sex")]
    public string? Sex { get; set; }
    [CascadingParameter(Name="Age")]
    public int Age { get; set; }
}</code></code></code></code></pre>
<p id="ucd3b231a" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><strong><span class="ne-text">需要注意的是如果在CascadingValue组件里面指定了Name参数，那么在所有CascadingParameter的地方也需要指定Name，否则就会找不到参数值。</span></strong></code></code></code></p>
</div>
</div>
